name: Wireless Earbuds
description: Pocket-sized earbuds with 30-hour battery life, active noise cancelling and a case that survives being sat on. Twice.

name: 4K Monitor
description: 27 inches of IPS panel, 99% sRGB and a stand that actually goes high enough. Your dashboards deserve this many pixels.

name: Mechanical Keyboard
description: Hot-swappable tactile switches, PBT keycaps and a satisfying thock that your coworkers will definitely notice.

name: USB-C Hub
description: Seven ports, 100 W pass-through charging and 4K HDMI. Ends the dongle drawer era for good.

name: Bluetooth Speaker
description: Palm-sized waterproof speaker with 20-hour battery and bass that punches well above its weight.

name: Smartwatch
description: Heart rate, sleep tracking, GPS runs and a week of battery. Tells the time, too, if you ask nicely.

name: Portable Power Bank
description: 20,000 mAh with 65 W USB-C output: charges a laptop once or a phone four times. Airline-friendly.

name: Mirrorless Camera
description: 24 MP sensor, eye-tracking autofocus and 4K video in a body small enough for a jacket pocket.

name: Running Shoes
description: Responsive foam, breathable knit upper and a rocker sole tuned for long, easy miles on road or treadmill.

name: Denim Jacket
description: Rigid selvedge denim that breaks in beautifully. Classic trucker cut with deep inside pockets for a phone and a paperback.

name: Cotton T-Shirt
description: Heavyweight organic cotton tee that keeps its shape after fifty washes. Comes in the only colour that matters: black.

name: Leather Wallet
description: Slim full-grain leather bifold with RFID blocking. Fits six cards, some cash, and zero receipts you will never read.

name: Canvas Backpack
description: Waxed canvas roll-top with a padded 16-inch laptop sleeve and a secret pocket for your passport.

name: Baseball Cap
description: Unstructured cotton twill cap with an adjustable brass buckle. Pre-washed for that lived-in look.

name: Knit Scarf
description: Chunky merino-blend scarf, long enough to wrap twice and soft enough to wear straight against the skin.

name: Polarized Sunglasses
description: Lightweight acetate frames with polarized UV400 lenses. Glare off, cool factor on.

name: Coffee Grinder
description: Conical burr grinder with 40 settings, from espresso fine to cold-brew coarse. Quiet enough for 6 a.m. deploys.

name: Air Purifier
description: True HEPA filter for rooms up to 40 m², with an auto mode that reacts to air quality and a whisper-quiet night setting.

name: Desk Lamp
description: Flicker-free LED arm lamp with five colour temperatures and a USB port in the base for your phone.

name: Ceramic Plant Pot
description: Hand-glazed stoneware pot with drainage and a bamboo saucer. The plant is sold separately, unfortunately.

name: Scented Candle
description: Soy wax candle in fig and cedar with a 45-hour burn. Makes any room smell like a boutique hotel.

name: Linen Throw Blanket
description: Stonewashed linen throw that gets softer every wash. Perfect for sofa naps and dramatic draping.

name: Matcha Tea Set
description: Ceremonial-grade matcha, a bamboo whisk and a ceramic bowl. Calm in a box, no barista required.

name: Analog Alarm Clock
description: Silent sweep hands for sleep, a proper bell for mornings. Keeps phones out of the bedroom.

name: Yoga Mat
description: 6 mm natural-rubber mat with a grippy top layer and alignment lines, so your downward dog stays pointed down.

name: Dumbbell Set
description: Adjustable 2–24 kg dumbbells with a quick-dial selector. Replaces an entire rack in your spare corner.

name: Cycling Helmet
description: Lightweight in-mould shell with MIPS protection, 18 vents and a rear light that clips on magnetically.

name: Insulated Water Bottle
description: Double-walled steel keeps drinks cold for 24 hours or hot for 12. Leak-proof lid, dishwasher-safe, dent-tolerant.

name: Tennis Racket
description: Graphite frame with a forgiving sweet spot, pre-strung at 55 lbs. Comes with a padded cover.

name: Outdoor Basketball
description: Grippy composite cover built for asphalt courts, with deep channels for control on fast breaks.

name: Boxing Gloves
description: 14 oz training gloves with layered foam, a breathable lining and a wrist strap that stays put.

name: Ultimate Frisbee
description: Regulation 175 g disc with a stable flight and a grippy rim. Beach days just got competitive.

name: Data Engineering Book
description: From batch to streaming: pipelines, orchestration, lakehouses and the art of idempotent reloads. Dog-ear friendly.

name: Sci-Fi Novel
description: A generation ship, a mutinous AI and a mystery 400 years in the making. You will read it in one weekend.

name: Streaming Systems Handbook
description: Watermarks, windows and exactly-once semantics explained with diagrams you can actually follow.

name: Cooking for Engineers
description: Recipes written as flowcharts, with timing diagrams for the tricky bits. Deterministic results, every time.

name: Astronomy for Night Owls
description: A season-by-season guide to what's up there tonight, with star maps that work with a cheap telescope.

name: Atlas of Mythic Dragons
description: Lavishly illustrated field guide to 80 dragons from world folklore, with habitats, diets and temperaments.

name: Pocket Notebook Trio
description: Three dot-grid notebooks that survive back pockets, rainy commutes and whiteboard-free meetings.

name: The Chemistry of Everything
description: Why bread rises, glue sticks and onions make you cry, explained one surprising molecule at a time.

name: Face Serum
description: Lightweight niacinamide and hyaluronic acid serum for glowy, hydrated skin. Fragrance-free and fuss-free.

name: Sunscreen SPF50
description: Broad-spectrum SPF50 that leaves no white cast and sits nicely under makeup. Reapply every two hours.

name: Clay Face Mask
description: Kaolin and green-tea clay mask that clears pores in ten minutes. Pairs well with a podcast.

name: Lip Balm Trio
description: Three shea-butter balms: unscented, mint and a sheer berry tint. One for every pocket.

name: Nail Polish Set
description: Six chip-resistant shades from barely-there nude to midnight teal. Dries in 60 seconds, lasts a week.

name: Konjac Sponge
description: Plant-based facial sponge that softens in water and gently buffs away the day. Biodegradable, too.

name: Rose Hand Cream
description: Rich shea and rosehip cream that sinks in fast, so you can get back to typing without greasy keys.

name: Silk Hair Scrunchies
description: Mulberry silk scrunchies in three colours. No dents, no snags, no losing them under the sofa (probably).
